digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: A hunter's name: its thorns were used to pick the brains out of a gazelle's skull.
teaser.sw: Jina la mwindaji: miiba yake ilitumika kuchokoa ubongo kutoka kwenye fuvu la swala.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra aindza: miyaye kala inahumirwa kutsokola *wongo* kula ndani ya zekeya ra chitswa cha swala.

summary.en: Mtsokola wongo, 'extractor of brain', is a spiny bush shrub whose thorns hunters used on the skulls of prey such as gazelle. Pakia's appendices disagree on whether the name belongs to Rytigynia celastroides or to Maytenus heterophylla.
summary.sw: Mtsokola wongo, 'mtoaji wa ubongo', ni kichaka chenye miiba cha porini ambacho miiba yake ilitumiwa na wawindaji kwenye mafuvu ya wanyama waliowinda kama swala. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu kama jina hili ni la Rytigynia celastroides au la Maytenus heterophylla.
summary.dg: *Mtsokola wongo*, 'anayetsokola *wongo*', ni chitsaka cha miya cha weruni, ambacho miyaye kala inahumirwa ni aindza kpwenye zekeya za maingo dza swala. Nyongeza za Pakia tazilengana kuhusu dzina hiri: kala ni ra *Rytigynia celastroides* au ra *Maytenus heterophylla*.

about.en: Rytigynia celastroides is a shrub of the coffee family with opposite, smallish, glossy leaves, small greenish-white flowers in the leaf angles and small round fruits that ripen black. Some forms carry short paired spines. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Rytigynia celastroides ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa) chenye majani yanayokabiliana, madogo kiasi na yanayong'aa, maua madogo ya kijani-nyeupe kwenye pembe za majani, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa meusi. Baadhi ya aina zake zina miiba mifupi iliyo jozi jozi. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Rytigynia celastroides* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye makodza madide chidide ganagolengana na ganang'ala, maruwa madide ga chijani na nyereru phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganagokala maru gachikala maivu. Aina zanjina zina miya mifupi, mairi-mairi. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest of East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na misitu mikavu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na matsaka makavu ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records that the thorns are used to extract the brain matter (wongo) from the skull of a prey animal such as a gazelle.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba miiba yake hutumika kutoa ubongo (wongo) kutoka kwenye fuvu la mnyama aliyewindwa kama swala.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala miyaye nkuhumirwa kutsokola *wongo* (wuongo) kula ndani ya zekeya ra chitswa cha nyama wa maingo, dza swala.

culture.en: The name belongs to the Digo hunting tradition, like Muoza nyama, the 'meat spoiler', which carries a message to the hunter.
culture.sw: Jina hili ni sehemu ya mapokeo ya uwindaji ya Wadigo, kama Muoza nyama, 'mharibu nyama', ambao hubeba ujumbe kwa mwindaji.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri ni ra mila ya Adigo ya kuindza, dza *Muoza nyama*, 'anayebananga nyama', ambao unamreha muindza ujumbe.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mtsokola wongo for Rytigynia celastroides. Appendix VI explains it as 'extractor of brain', from tsokola (to extract) and wongo (brain). However, Appendices V and VI give this name to Maytenus heterophylla and call Rytigynia celastroides Mtsokola ng’ongo instead. Mgombato confirms tsokola as to poke or pick out with a stick.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mtsokola wongo kwa Rytigynia celastroides. Kiambatisho VI kinalifafanua kuwa 'mtoaji wa ubongo', kutoka tsokola (kutoa) na wongo (ubongo). Hata hivyo, Viambatisho V na VI vinalipa jina hili Maytenus heterophylla na kuiita Rytigynia celastroides Mtsokola ng’ongo badala yake. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsokola maana yake ni kuchokoa au kutoa kwa kijiti.
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Mtsokola wongo* kpwa *Rytigynia celastroides*. Nyongeza VI inaeleza kukala ni 'anayetsokola *wongo*', kula *tsokola* (kutuluza) na *wongo* (wuongo). Ela Nyongeza V na VI zinapha dzina hiri *Maytenus heterophylla*, na *Rytigynia celastroides* zinauiha *Mtsokola ng’ongo*. Mgombato unakubali kukala *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula kobo kpwa chigongo.

reason.en: The paired name; the two are swapped between appendices
reason.sw: Jina pacha; majina haya mawili yamebadilishana kati ya viambatisho
reason.dg: Dzina myawe; nyongeza za Pakia zinagabadilisha madzina higa mairi

reason.en: Related shrub of the coffee family
reason.sw: Kichaka kinachohusiana nacho, cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa)
reason.dg: Chitsaka cha jamii iyo iyo ya kahawa

mgombato: tsokola to clear out a hole with a stick; to poke, to pick at something;
